WITH winner_records AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.year, res.position, res.positionOrder, res.positionText,
           res.milliseconds, res.time
    FROM main.races AS r
    JOIN main.results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.year < 1975
      AND (res.position = 1 OR res.positionOrder = 1 OR res.positionText = '1')
),
race_counts AS (
    SELECT raceId, COUNT(*) AS winner_rows,
           COUNT(DISTINCT milliseconds) AS distinct_times
    FROM winner_records
    GROUP BY raceId
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.races AS r WHERE r.year < 1975) AS races_before_1975,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM race_counts) AS races_with_winner_records,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM race_counts WHERE distinct_times = 1) AS races_with_one_time,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM race_counts WHERE distinct_times > 1) AS races_with_conflicting_times,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM race_counts WHERE winner_rows > 1) AS races_with_multiple_winner_rows,
    COUNT(*) AS winner_records,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE position IS NOT 1 OR positionOrder IS NOT 1 OR positionText IS NOT '1') AS winner_indicator_disagreements,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE milliseconds IS NULL) AS missing_millisecond_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND typeof(milliseconds) <> 'integer') AS noninteger_millisecond_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE time IS NULL OR time NOT GLOB '[0-9]*:[0-9]*:[0-9]*') AS rows_without_elapsed_text,
    MIN(milliseconds) AS min_milliseconds,
    MAX(milliseconds) AS max_milliseconds
FROM winner_records

WITH winner_records AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.raceId, res.milliseconds,
           substr(res.time, 1, instr(res.time, ':') - 1) AS hours,
           substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1) AS minutes_and_seconds
    FROM main.races AS r
    JOIN main.results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.year < 1975 AND res.position = 1
),
winner_times AS (
    SELECT *,
           CAST(hours AS INTEGER) * 3600000
           + CAST(minutes_and_seconds AS INTEGER) * 60000
           + CAST(substr(minutes_and_seconds, instr(minutes_and_seconds, ':') + 1) AS INTEGER) * 1000
           + CAST(substr(substr(minutes_and_seconds, instr(minutes_and_seconds, '.') + 1) || '000', 1, 3) AS INTEGER)
               AS text_milliseconds
    FROM winner_records
),
yearly AS (
    SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS races, SUM(milliseconds) AS sum_ms
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT year, raceId, milliseconds FROM winner_records)
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT year, races, sum_ms,
       sum_ms % (10 * races) AS rounding_remainder,
       5 * races AS halfway_remainder,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM winner_times AS w
        WHERE w.year = yearly.year AND w.text_milliseconds IS NOT w.milliseconds) AS text_time_mismatches
FROM yearly
ORDER BY year

arguments.sql:
WITH race_winner_times AS (
    -- Shared winners can repeat the same elapsed time for a race.
    SELECT DISTINCT r.year, r.raceId, res.milliseconds
    FROM main.races AS r
    JOIN main.results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.year < 1975
      AND res.position = 1
      AND res.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    year,
    -- Round the nonnegative mean to whole hundredths using integer arithmetic.
    ((SUM(milliseconds) + 5 * COUNT(*)) / (10 * COUNT(*))) / 100.0
        AS mean_winner_elapsed_seconds
FROM race_winner_times
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year
LIMIT -1
